content: Fiye 12:1-9 Bepaŋdi Abalam Kahileeŋ Kutniŋguk
Kaŋ Bepaŋdi Abalam niŋguk, “Du kwake mebi eŋ magemageye eŋ yokekwake biyabudapmaaŋ nuku kwet niŋ ganindakalewit uŋoŋ wooŋ hatibaaŋ.
Kaŋ nu kahaŋ tigambene yalakigeye fee mintaulihaka tubune du’walaŋ woho gigitdi hautadapmawaak. Kaŋ du da ye wahu kahaŋ wondiniŋ mebi tibaaŋ.

Nebek niŋdi du gehikahaŋneneeŋ adi adi kibi nubo adi yehikahaŋnewaat eŋ nebek niŋdi ganisilone tineeŋ adi adi kibi nubo yenisilone tibaat. Tiŋa du’walaniŋ kahaŋdi kwetkwet metam wanakaŋ tokidapmayembaak.”
Kaŋ Abalam adi Wapum diniŋ mede tagimneeŋ talik tububihila ulune Loti adi takaliŋa wanaŋ noŋgoŋ ugumuk. Abalam adi guletŋiŋ 75 tubune Halan kwet bikabuŋa uguk.
Adi tamuŋiŋ Salai eŋ dali diniŋ mihi Loti eŋ adi’walaŋ tipilapilaye eŋ bomboŋŋiŋ wanaŋ moŋgolune Kanaaŋ kwetneŋkade uge uge kwet uŋaŋ usuwagiŋ.
Usuwaaŋ dapmaaŋ ugiŋ uge uge Sekem yokwetneŋ usuwagiŋ. Uŋoŋ adi me kwehiwahi’walaŋ bem muŋgohom
niŋ dokoniŋgoŋ yobune yatuguk. Nai uŋaniŋ adi Kanaaŋ metam adi kwet wondiniŋ molom hatigiŋ.
Kaŋ Wapumdi Abalam mintamiŋa yoguk, “Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, kwet yoŋ adi yalakigeye yembaat.” Kaŋ Abalam adi Wapumdi mintamiŋa mede niŋguk doktiŋa kwet uŋgoŋ Wapumdok alata niŋ tuguk.

Tiŋa kotigoŋ kwet haŋgineŋkade looŋ uge uge Betele yokwet mele fofoŋneŋkade ikuk eŋ Ai yokwet mele labulabuneŋkade ikuk uŋgoŋ houle yot maguk. Tiŋa Abalam adi uŋgoŋ Wapum alata niŋ timiŋa wou nintilooŋ niutumbaguk.
Tiŋa kotigoŋ pilaliŋa Negep kwetneŋkade uguk.
Fiye 12: 10-20 Abalam adi Isip kwetneŋ uguk
Kanaaŋ kwet wapumneŋ uŋoŋ mele wapum yalune map wapum mintaguk doktiŋa Abalamdi Isip kwetneŋkade nai muniniŋ hatibene uŋoŋ uguk.
Ala Isip kwet tubudulaaŋ tamuŋiŋ Salai indiŋ niŋguk, “Nadilaŋ be? Du adi tam folonamandapge momooŋ hinek u nu kaule mu tilat.
Isip me adi gabuŋa indiŋ yoneŋ, ‘Biyagoŋ hinek, ya tamuŋiŋ ne’walaŋ’ yoŋa nulukumuŋ tineeŋ eŋ du adi bigabune hatibaaŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa indiŋ yobaaŋ, ‘Nu adi adi’walaŋ wiwi’ unduŋ yobaaŋ kaŋ adi dutok tiŋa nu kedem binabuune hatibaat.”
Ala Abalam adi agaŋ Isip kwetneŋ usuaune Isip me adi tam diniŋ folonamandapŋiŋ momooŋ hatibune kagiŋ.
Tiŋa Felo’walaŋ
me wapuhi adi Felo’walaŋ bop ginaŋ hatiŋa tam aditok yogalika kisaŋ tigiŋ. Tiŋa tam u nagila Felo’walaŋ yolineŋ ugiŋ.
Kaŋ Felo adi Salai doktiŋa Abalam siloŋ kisaŋ timiŋa, dompa, makau, doŋki eŋ tipilapilaye metam eŋ kamele fee hinek mintoiguk.
Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Wapum adi Abalam tamuŋiŋ Salai doktiŋa Felo meŋimeŋiye yagit folofigita kisaŋ yemiŋguk.
Unduŋ tubune Felodi Abalam kutnimbune buune indiŋ ninadiguk, “I maŋgoŋ kudi tinamuŋguŋ? Adi tamune unduŋ maŋgoŋde mu naniŋguŋ?
Adi witne unduŋ maŋgoŋde yobune tam i nutok tibek yoŋa yotneneŋ nagi logut? Pilap hinek tamge nagila momooŋ tiŋa u!”
Unduŋ yoŋa Felodi memikŋiye yeniŋkulune Abalam ne eŋ tamuŋiŋ eŋ bomboŋhik tiulidokoyemiŋa yapmeune kwehite ugiŋ.

footnotes.text: Bem woŋ adi Iŋglis mede gineŋ “oak” yoiŋ.
Isiphi’walaŋ mapmehik mintayagiŋ indigoŋ tuwot adi wouhiye Felo yeniyagiŋ.
